businesses.name: Durable Parts (also listed as Liquid Gold Enterprise)

businesses.customers: DIY enthusiasts, restorers and independent shops working on older Chrysler/Dodge and other vehicles; nationwide online buyers.

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 2: profile is claimed with 5.0/8 reviews and the site is indexed, but robots.txt blocks the major AI crawlers by name. Answerable 1: product pages and a sitemap exist, but I could not read a single one - Cloudflare served a verification interstitial on every attempt, and there is no accessible hours/address text off the Maps listing. Bookable 0: checkout may exist for humans who pass the challenge, but no agent or assisted customer can get that far; no appointment or quote path was reachable.

scores.reasons: Gap 3: catalogue and brand exist but bot protection and duplicate listings undercut reach. Ability to pay 4: real e-commerce with a very large catalogue and repeat order volume. Ease 2: changes touch Cloudflare/WAF and a big WooCommerce catalogue, and I could not inspect the site. Evidence 2: site unreadable behind the challenge; conclusions rest on robots.txt, Maps and search results.

caveats: Google Maps served a limited, logged-out view for every query, so review counts were frequently not displayed even where a star rating was; ratings are reported as shown and counts marked unknown rather than guessed.

Browser-rendered document titles in this environment carried an injected emoji prefix that is absent from the raw HTML (verified with a raw fetch of ulaundromat.com), so title issues were judged from the underlying page content, not that prefix.
Scores are comparative within this batch of small Highland Park main-street businesses, not against national benchmarks.
No forms were submitted and no payments were started anywhere; 'bookable' reflects what is visible and reachable without submitting.
data_gaps: Google review counts not visible for most listings in the limited Maps view (Infinite Minds, 88 Appliances, Wonderland Flora, Raspa, Beamesderfer, Mason Resnick, The Upcycle).
University Laundromat's Google listing was not retrieved at all; rating and review count are unknown.

Rainbow Cleaners has no website and no first-party page; its operating status is inferred from a thin Google listing ('Raritan Rainbow Cleaners', custom tailor, no reviews, different phone) and directory reviews referencing a re-opening under new management. Identification of that listing as the same shop is an inference and should be confirmed by phone.

durable.parts could not be read: Cloudflare served a bot-verification interstitial on repeated attempts and was not bypassed. Product content, contact routes, mobile layout and checkout were therefore not assessed.
88 Appliances' GBP phone (732-732-8899) differs from the site (732-732-8866); which is current is unconfirmed.
Mason Resnick's second brand (generationsphotorestoration.com) was reviewed from its home and pricing pages only; checkout/order flow not tested.
